derivation:
by
  simpa [ODE.picard, hX.1] using (ODE.picard_eq_of_hasDerivAt (t₀ := s) (t := t) (u := Set.univ)
    hb.smooth.continuous.continuousOn (fun r _ => (hX.2 x s r).hasDerivWithinAt) (by simp [Set.MapsTo])).symm
explanation: Specialize the Picard integral-equation theorem to the trajectory r ↦ X r x s and the unrestricted spatial domain. Smoothness supplies continuity; unfolding picard and rewriting the initial condition gives the result. The existing proof instead uses the fundamental theorem of calculus.
